notes: Shevelev's conjecture for all odd k, both equations: alternate_eq / alternate_ne (tm n = (Nat.digits 2 n).sum % 2; consecutive solutions n < n' have tm n != tm n'). Route: P(n) = sum_{m<n} (-1)^tm m is 0 at even n and +-1 at odd n; 2Q(n) = P(n) + P(n+k) - P(k) (two_Q) so the signed count Q over solutions stays in {0, -P(k)} (QR_range), forcing alternation; same with 2R = P(n) - P(n+k) + P(k). k = 9: alternate_eq. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none.
